entries.title: Proverbs 14:1
segments: A wise woman builds her house, but the foolish plucks it down with her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:2
segments: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but [he who is] perverse in his ways despises Him.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:3
segments: In the mouth of the foolish [is] a rod of pride, but the lips of the wise shall keep them.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:4
segments: Where no cattle [are], the stall [is] clean, but much gain [is] by the strength of the ox.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:5
segments: A faithful witness will not lie, but a false witness will speak lies.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:6
segments: A scorner seeks wisdom, and it is not [found], but knowledge [is] easy to him who understands.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:7
segments: Go from the before a foolish man when you do not see [in him] the lips of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:8
segments: The wisdom of the wise [is] to understand his way, but the folly of fools [is] deceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:9
segments: Fools laugh at sin, but among the righteous [there is] favor.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:10
segments: The heart knows its own bitterness, and a stranger does not share in its joy.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:11
segments: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown, but the tent of the upright shall be blessed.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:12
segments: There is a way which seems right to a man, but the end of it [is] the ways of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:13
segments: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful, and the end of that joy [is] heaviness.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:14
segments: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways, but a good man from himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:15
segments: The simple believes every word, but the wise man watches his step.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:16
segments: A wise one fears and departs from evil, but the fool rages and is sure.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:17
segments: He who [is] soon angry acts foolishly, and a man of wicked plots is hated.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:18
segments: The simple inherit folly, but the wise are crowned with knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:19
segments: The evil bow before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:20
segments: The poor is hated even by his own neighbor, but the rich [has] many friends.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:21
segments: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has mercy on the poor, happy [is] he.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:22
segments: Do not those who think evil go astray? But mercy and truth shall be to those who think of good.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:23
segments: In all labor there is gain, but the talk of the lips [tends] only to poverty.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:24
segments: The crown of the wise [is] their riches [of wisdom]; the foolishness of fools [is] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:25
segments: A true witness delivers souls, but a deceitful witness speaks lies.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:26
segments: In the fear of the LORD [is] strong hope, and His sons shall have a place of refuge.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:27
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] a fountain of life to turn aside from the snares of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:28
segments: In the multitude of people [is] the king's honor, but in the lack of people [is] the ruin of the prince.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:29
segments: [He who is] slow to wrath [is] of great understanding, but [he who is] hasty of spirit exalts folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:30
segments: A sound heart [is] the life of the flesh, but envy the rottenness of the bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:31
segments: He who presses the poor curses his Maker, but he who honors Him has mercy upon the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:32
segments: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness, but the righteous [has] hope in his death.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:33
segments: Wisdom rests in the heart of him who has understanding, but among fools it is made known.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:34
segments: Righteousness lifts up a nation, but sin [is] a shame to any people.

entries.title: Proverbs 14:35
segments: The king's favor [is] toward a wise servant, but his wrath is against him who causes shame.
